searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, sent-log.json (last ~40 'opportunities' entries: Palantir FDE, Anthropic Fellows x5 variants, Sierra APX x3 variants + early-career page, OpenAI emerging talent, Databricks APM New Grad, Modal, Scale AI university, Gooseworks all sent within the last ~10 days), applications.json (empty; life/PIPELINE.md is the real tracker), and life/PIPELINE.md for exclusions (IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Tuck Business Bridge). Checked the graduation-date conflict flagged in this run's instructions: both morning-briefing/profile.md and life/PROFILE.md now independently state December 2026, resolved 2026-08-04 by Dom -- no live conflict; the instructions describing an 'unsettled Aug-Dec 2026' split are stale at the source and should be corrected there. Planned to rotate into companies not recently sent (Nvidia New College Grad Solutions Architect, Ramp emerging-talent FDE, Meta RPM program, Google APM cycle, Stripe New Grad Accelerator, Cohere BDR/internships, Together AI GTM Engineer, Notion Early Career) plus 2-3 searches for non-company fellowships. Sanity-checked WebFetch before spending budget: attempted 10 distinct hosts (nvidia.com, ramp.com, metacareers.com, google.com, stripe.com, api.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, notion.com, www.anthropic.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io) -- every single one returned EGRESS_BLOCKED before the request left the proxy. Confirmed with a raw Bash curl to two of them (anthropic.com, greenhouse.io) -- both got 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' from the egress proxy, i.e. an organization-level policy denial, not a per-tool or per-domain issue. WebSearch itself still works fine. hunt.md's own honesty rules require confirming eligibility and open-application status from the actual page -- a search snippet or aggregator listing is explicitly disallowed as sole evidence -- so no candidate, however plausible from search results, could be verified and none is included. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output. This is not a one-off: git log on this repo shows the identical WebFetch-blocked failure on every hunt run back to at least 2026-08-18 (self-reported '21st', '25th', '26th', '27th', '29th' consecutive day in recent commit messages) -- roughly four straight weeks where this routine has been structurally unable to verify or surface a single opportunity, unfixed across every prior report. This is an environment/org-level network-egress-policy problem (the destination job-board and careers domains are not allowlisted for this session), not a lack of findable roles or a search-budget shortfall, and needs a human to fix the network policy for this environment -- see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web for how environment egress policy is configured.
